title: Motion (Park – Hutt) relative to an assessment of cost, funding opportunities, and resources needed to widen the Marvin Braude Bike Trail through Venice…
text:
[Council File 26-1136; CD 11]
Motion (Park – Hutt) relative to an assessment of cost, funding opportunities, and resources needed to widen the Marvin Braude Bike Trail through Venice Beach in order to accommodate a pedestrian path in time for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted

outcome.text: Council adopted item forthwith (Sep 29, 2026); Council action final
